confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of South Korean price levels, not checked against live menus, rate cards, or booking pages. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with the July peak season and Haeundae beach-area demand. Cocktail and wine anchors are bounded using the local price relationship to beer where direct knowledge is weaker. Expect a plausible range of roughly ±25% per anchor.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is South Korean domestic price levels for a large regional port city, set below Seoul and near other large Korean and Japanese regional cities such as Fukuoka and Osaka for restaurant and drink prices. Guesthouse and hostel anchors reflect Busan's beach and central districts in peak summer.
